results.degree_pruning: Monic specialization at the squarefree center gives exact U-degrees for G and its cofactor, including nonreduced fibers. results.linear_center_ring: For a linear center with quadratic second projection, exact division and the full triple-ring equality yield O=L[theta,wtilde]. The odd-part argument gives wtilde=P(theta)+b1x over L, so C=L[x^2,x^3+c1x] is proper with defect one and exact conductor RO. The plane is geometrically nodal for nonzero c1 and cuspidal for c1=0.
